summary: Completed testing of CRM Dashboard with RBAC implementation. Fixed critical backend RBAC issue where default permissions were insufficient. Fixed frontend RBACContext token key mismatch. However, sidebar navigation items are still not rendering despite RBAC loading correctly with 22 permissions. Root cause appears to be a React component re-rendering issue where the Sidebar component doesn't update after RBAC context loads.

critical_bugs.root_cause: React component not re-rendering after RBAC context loads, OR hasPermission function not working correctly despite permissions being loaded
